summary: Iter220 retest of the iter219 fixes. All pass. (1) HIGH bug FIXED: in Alice's Quick Call ShowAsSelect dialog, saving a no-code caller ID via caller-ids-attest-submit closes the dialog right away. The new chip appears first (quick-call-show-as-select-option-0 = +14155552301, aria-checked=true; chips went from 3 to 4) and the toast shows. Bob saw the same after his upgrade. (2) Web BizUpgrade with Bob's +18509558201 reset to pro/75: the confirm says $45.00. Then POST upgrade (quote), POST upgrade (confirm) and GET /dashboard run, and the header topbar-balance goes from $129.55 to $84.55 without a reload. In the DB the plan is business/120, expiresAt is unchanged (2026-12-01T22:02:04.242Z) and phoneTransactions shows amount 45.00, credit 0.00. The upsell box disappears and Add caller ID becomes enabled. (3) Light theme: .civr-upsell-text computes to rgb(180,83,9) (#b45309) and is readable. (4) API, new pytest 8/8: the cap counts ALL verified IDs (3 auto + 7 attested = 10, then too_many_presets). Presets slice to 10 even with 13 verified. An explicit upgrade number that is replaced (Bob +19522349029), a sub-number (Alice +12138340888), suspended (temporary flip of Bob +14062358695, restored) or unknown returns 404 not_found. Valid quotes: Pro $45, Starter $70. Bot regression on mock TG :5099 was NOT run (optional, skipped).

integration_issues.issue: The header wallet now updates. However, on the same page the Quick Call 'Call from' select still reads '+18509558201 · Pro' and the Presets card still shows the 'Business' lock until reload. QuickCall's /numbers data is not refreshed. Low priority.

action_items: Optional: after BizUpgrade, also refresh the page-level /numbers data (Quick Call 'Call from' plan label and the Presets lock) so it shows Business without a reload.
critical_code_review_comments: attest() cap check (countDocuments) and replaceOne are still not atomic, so parallel requests could exceed 10. Low risk, unchanged from iter219.
seed_data_creation: Bob's +18509558201 was set back to pro/75 as requested, then upgraded again via the web UI. It is now business/120 again and Bob's wallet is $84.55 (another $45 charged). The test caller IDs +14155552301 (Alice) and +14155552302 (Bob) and the pytest-created IDs were deleted by id. Alice is back to her 3 auto IDs.
